source.name: SportsPro, Manchester United confirm Qualcomm front-of-shirt sponsorship
source.quote: Agreement reportedly worth more than UK£60 million (US$74.8 million) per year
source.note: Deal announced 13 September 2023, running from 2024/25; The Athletic reported a minimum of three years. Score and Change (17 Sep 2026) reports the current deal runs until at least 2029.

note: Reported GBP60m a year, among the largest shirt deals in the league.
